title: The Double Debt
author: Kestrel Brightwater
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
